description: This file defines the CliLoggerHandler class which extends Monolog's StreamHandler to perform logging specifically for CLI output, with color formatting and minimalism. It is part of the SuiteCRM logging system.

classes.name: CliLoggerHandler
classes.description: A custom log handler extending StreamHandler, specialized for CLI output with color formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with stderr output and sets a CLI formatter.
